connector.name: MCP Server Clawhub
connector.registryDescription: ClawHub.ai skill catalog: search, browse, inspect, and download skills (token unlocks publish).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server-clawhub. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aiwerk account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CLAWHUB_TOKEN
env.description: ClawHub API token. Optional: read-only browsing works without it; required to publish or delete.
